image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a silver-colored metal breastplate (cuirass) displayed on a black mannequin torso. The armor features intricate vertical embossed floral or scrollwork patterns down the center and sides. It has a high collar with a horizontal slit opening at the throat. The surface is polished but shows signs of age or texture, not perfectly mirror-like. A leather strap is visible on the right side.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like 'cuirass' or 'body armor' based on visual features.
To analyze the realism of the metal reflections, embossed details, and check for any subtle AI-generated texture smearing or inconsistency in the ornamental patterns.
To verify the 3D curvature of the armor and ensure the embossed patterns have correct depth relative to the base plate, checking for 'flat' looking reliefs.
To ensure the boundaries of the armor against the background and mannequin are sharp and physically consistent, checking for edge bleeding.

focus_areas: Consistency of specular highlights on curved surfaces
Structural plausibility of the collar/throat opening
Edge sharpness between armor and background
